posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform Alibaba's Qwen Audio 3.0 TTS Plus tops the competition in the text-to-speech rankings The Decoder · 🟣 Qwen · 12m ago • Alibaba's Qwen Audio 3.0 TTS Plus ranks first on Artificial Analysis' Speech Arena leaderboard. • Model supports 16 languages and allows natural language control over speaking style with tags like [angry]. • Speech generation at 16 characters per second lags behind competitors Sonic 3.5.
